title: buildzr model export (buildzr.model/2)
description: The model the viewer is about: every element with its containment, explicit relationships only, and authored views. Written by buildzr/site/model.py as canonical JSON (sort_keys, compact separators, UTF-8, trailing newline). Design note v4, section C. Readers MUST ignore element 'type' values they do not know (deployment types arrive later).

modelHash.description: sha256 of the canonical bytes of this object with modelHash set to the empty string.

elements.description: Pre-order depth-first over the containment tree (every parent before its children). Roots in model order: people first, then software systems; children in model order.

relationships.description: Explicit relationships only: none that buildzr implied (Structurizr linkedRelationshipId). Sorted by id.

environments.description: Empty in v4; reserved for deployment (design C).

path.description: Slug path: parent path + '/' + slug(name). slug = lower-case, runs of characters outside [a-z0-9] become '-', trimmed of '-'; empty -> 'element'. On collision among siblings (or among roots) the 2nd, 3rd ... in model order get '-2', '-3' ...

modelId.description: Structurizr numeric id as exported today (not stable across edits).

type.description: v4 writes Person, SoftwareSystem, Container, Component. Later: DeploymentNode, InfrastructureNode, ContainerInstance, SoftwareSystemInstance. Readers ignore unknown types.

tags.description: As in the Structurizr JSON (insertion order, defaults first). Never re-sorted.

group.description: Group name, nested groups joined by '/' as Structurizr writes them.

views.description: Keys of the authored views this element appears in, in workspace view order.

id.description: '<source path>-><destination path>'; when a pair has several relationships, every one of them gets ':<slug(description)>' (empty description -> 'rel'), with '-2', '-3' ... on remaining collisions in model order.

scope.description: Scoped element path; null for landscape/deployment views.
